people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Barzillai
people.line: A Gileadite who provided for David during Absalom's rebellion.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Lo-debar
people.line: A town in Gilead; home of Mephibosheth

people.name: Mahanaim
people.line: A place east of the Jordan; David's refuge

people.name: Nahash
people.line: King of the Ammonites, provided supplies to David.

people.name: Shobi
people.line: Ammonite who provided supplies to David at Mahanaim.

translations.web: When David had come to Mahanaim, Shobi the son of Nahash of Rabbah of the children of Ammon, and Machir the son of Ammiel of Lodebar, and Barzillai the Gileadite of Rogelim,
translations.bsb: When David came to Mahanaim, he was met by Shobi son of Nahash from Rabbah of the Ammonites, Machir son of Ammiel from Lo-debar, and Barzillai the Gileadite from Rogelim.
